hero.heading: Our Roots in the Wilderness
hero.subtitle: Discover the passion, heritage, and unwavering commitment to conservation that drives Pande Wilderness Safari.

story.heading: A Legacy of Authentic Exploration
story.paragraph1: For over 15 years, Pande Wilderness Safari has been more than a tour operator; we are custodians of the Tanzanian wilderness. Founded by local experts with a profound love for the land, our mission is to share the untouched beauty of Africa while fiercely protecting it for generations to come.
story.paragraph2: We believe in travel that enriches both the soul of the explorer and the communities that call this wild landscape home. Every journey we craft is a testament to our commitment to sustainable, low-impact, and highly authentic safari experiences.
story.imageAlt: A Tanzanian safari guide standing proudly beside an open-top Land Cruiser in the Serengeti.

conservation.title: Conservation First
conservation.description: We partner with local wildlife funds to ensure our footprint is positive.

community.title: Community Led
community.description: 100% of our guides are locals, reinvesting in our shared heritage.

team.heading: Meet the Experts
team.subtitle: Our seasoned team of naturalists, trackers, and hospitality experts ensure your journey is flawless.

inquiry.heading: Start Planning Your Journey
inquiry.subtitle: Share a few details, and our safari experts will begin crafting your bespoke Tanzanian adventure.
inquiry.helperText: Pick your regions and dates and we'll have a specialist reply with a quote. Prefer to talk first? Use the WhatsApp or email details alongside.
inquiry.chatBody: Speak directly with our local guides on WhatsApp. We promise a reply within 24 hours to help shape your ideal itinerary.
